item.title: Hong Kong: ASTRI Explores AI Tools for Engineering Operations
item.description: A Hong Kong research collaboration explores AI technologies including document intelligence, speech analytics and CAD analysis to improve infrastructure operations, compliance monitoring and efficiency.

item.title: Vietnam: AI Law Establishes National Governance Framework
item.description: Vietnam’s new AI Law establishes a human-centred governance framework to manage risks, promote innovation, ensure transparency and build a skilled workforce for a responsible, future-ready AI ecosystem.

item.title: Singapore Strengthens Technology and Innovation Leadership
item.description: Singapore’s COS 2026 outlines A*STAR-led initiatives to advance AI, semiconductor and biomedical research and low-carbon technologies, strengthening the nation’s innovation ecosystem and future-ready economy.

item.title: Malaysia: Technology and Digital Infrastructure Fuel Record Investment
item.description: Malaysia’s investment growth highlights expanding digital infrastructure, advanced manufacturing and innovation-driven industries supporting technological development and regional economic resilience.

item.title: Indonesia: Driving AI Literacy While Safeguarding Critical Thinking
item.description: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka urged Indonesian educators, parents and students to fully embrace AI literacy while maintaining critical thinking, ethical awareness and responsible digital use.

item.title: Australia: AI and 3D Printing Enable Next-Gen Materials
item.description: Researchers combine artificial intelligence and metal 3D printing to accelerate discovery of high-temperature alloys designed for advanced aerospace, energy and defence systems.

item.title: The Philippines: Building a Safer Digital World for Children
item.description: The Philippine government and partner organisations are combining digital literacy initiatives, parental guidance and justice reforms to protect children from online and offline abuse, strengthening safety nationwide.

item.title: Hong Kong: Government Begins Legal Review to Support AI
item.description: Hong Kong begins reviewing legislation to support artificial intelligence adoption, aiming to balance innovation, governance and regulatory oversight across government sectors.

item.title: Vietnam: National AI Development Fund to Accelerate Innovation
item.description: Vietnam is establishing a national AI development fund to boost innovation, research and practical applications while fostering a collaborative, technology-driven ecosystem nationwide.

item.title: NUS Singapore Integrates AI Tools to Develop AI-Native Graduates
item.description: NUS Singapore is integrating advanced AI tools into its computing curriculum, giving students hands-on experience with AI-enabled development while strengthening core computer science foundations.
